```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r sourcing, include=FALSE}
#source the R folder to load any packages and functions
lapply(dir('R', '*.R', full.names = TRUE), source)

#read in finalized data
dat <- readRDS("Output/Data/final_data_litters.rds")

#get density quantiles
dens25Q <- dat[, round(quantile(density_std)[2], 2)]
dens75Q <- dat[, round(quantile(density_std)[4], 2)]

#categorize density based on quantiles
dat[density_std < dens25Q, density_cat := "low"]
dat[density_std > dens25Q & density_std < dens75Q, density_cat := "medium"]
dat[density_std > dens75Q, density_cat := "high"]

#make factor with levels
dat[, density_cat := factor(density_cat, levels = c("low", "medium", "high"))]

#make control only data set
control <- dat[grid == "SU" | grid == "KL"]

#make food treatment data set, All food add except the weird two years in KL
food <- dat[food == 1 & !grid == "KL"]  #just food add

#make cache data set
cacheyears <- dat[!is.na(cache_prev), unique(year)]  #get years with cache size data
cache <- dat[(grid == "SU" | grid == "KL") & year %in% cacheyears]  #only long term control grids



```


## Preliminary Analysis

Below is the basic relationship between growth rate, litter size, and density.

```{r fig1, include = TRUE}

#this model is Growth Rate ~ Litter Size x Local Density Category
bmod <- lm(growthrate ~ littersize*density_cat, control)
anova(bmod)

bmod_pred <- as.data.table(ggpredict(bmod, terms = c("littersize", "density_cat"))) #soluble biomass (sb)


#plot regressions on top of raw data
ggplot() +
  #geom_point(aes(x = littersize, y = growthrate, color = density_cat), alpha = 0.3, data = control) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = group), alpha = 0.2, data = bmod_pred) +
  geom_line(aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group), data = bmod_pred)+
  labs(x = "Litter size", y = "Growth rate (g/day)", color = "Density", fill = "Density") +
  theme_bw()

```


Next, same thing but using the food data set. Add in food treatment as factor.


```{r food mod, include = FALSE}

#this model is Growth Rate ~ Litter Size x Density Category x Food Treatment
fmod <- lm(growthrate ~ littersize*density_cat*treatment_food, food)
anova(fmod)

#get effects table
food_effs <- as.data.table(ggpredict(fmod, terms = c("littersize", "density_cat", "treatment_food")))

#plot regressions on top of raw data
ggplot(food_effs)+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, group = group, fill = group), alpha = 0.2)+
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted, x = x, color = group, group = group), linewidth = 1)+
  labs(x = "Litter size", y = "Growth rate (g/day)", subtitle = "Grid Treatment")+
  facet_wrap(~facet)+
  theme_bw()

```



```{r fig2, include = TRUE}

fmod <- lm(growthrate ~ littersize*density_cat*treatment_food, food)
anova(fmod)

ggplot(food, aes(x = littersize, y = growthrate, group = interaction(density_cat, treatment_food))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, aes(color = density_cat)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", aes(color = density_cat), se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~treatment_food, labeller = label_both) +
  labs(x = "Litter size", y = "Growth rate (g/day)", color = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r fig2 but standardized, include = TRUE}

fmod_std <- lm(growthrate_std ~ littersize_std*density_cat*treatment_food, food)
anova(fmod_std)

ggplot(food, aes(x = littersize_std, y = growthrate_std, group = interaction(density_cat, treatment_food))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, aes(color = density_cat)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", aes(color = density_cat), se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~treatment_food, labeller = label_both) +
  labs(x = "Litter size", y = "Growth rate (g/day)", color = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

```
